title: LSD-47  2A MPDE CYLINDER HEAD; REPLACE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC YOKOSUKA.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR  YOKOSUKA
detail_text: This is a Synopsis notice only. This is not a solicitation or request for proposal and no contract will be awarded from this notice. This information in this notification is subject to change and in no way binds the US Government to award a contract. USS RUSHMORE (LSD-47) 2A MPDE CYLINDER HEAD; REPLACE POP: from 08/24/2026 to 10/31/2026 Place of Performance: Commander, Fleet Activities Sasebo (CFAS) in Japan. The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Yokosuka Site “SASEBO” will issue a competitive solicitation to Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) and capable Agreement for Boat Repair (ABR) holders in "Japan only". Please ensure that your company meets these criteria and provides any necessary documentation to demonstrate your authorization to perform this work in “Japan”.
